steps.content: The white light fades and you cross the curtain, entering the inside of the Black Ring.
The murky Rust has vanished, together with those mad Corruptors, those menacing black spikes, and that enormous red luminous ring. They have all vanished.
Something is floating down from the sky. You look up and see colorful confetti.
Against the sunny bright sky, a beautiful banner is spread above the amusement park's gate—Welcome to the Carnival.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What? What is this? Why does it look like this inside the Ring?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Where's the Black Ring? And that Hamel? And all... all those monsters rushing in from the Rust?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahhhh!
She gets hit by something.
Welcome to the land of endless love and joy!
The bunny mascot at the gate is dressed in a ceremonial guard costume and carrying a small drum on its back, beckoning to the visitors.

steps.speaker: Bunny Mascot
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>Carnival's parade</color> is about to begin! The <color=#fb9259>Carnival's parade</color> is about to begin!
You walk closer to the Carnival's gate, and the bunny mascot freezes for a few seconds. After some cogwheel squeaks, the bunny mascot suddenly reaches out a hand toward you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, watch out!
The three of you are startled, but it only sprinkles a handful of confetti at you, then continues drumming.

steps.speaker: Bunny Mascot
steps.content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome...! Welcome...!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew... That scared me. Is it just a robot?
You give it a squeeze. It's soft, you find no trace of metal.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Someone's coming.
To put it precisely, a whole reveling parade is coming. The joyful music, mixed with people's laughter, is crashing near like waves.
On a platform lifted up by mascots and a maneki-neko, a human whose head is replaced by a television is surrounded by flowers. It's announcing something with a microphone.

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: Carnival! Carnival! This is the DisCity's Carnival!

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: Disasters are behind us, paradise is here again! O our great city, pain and fear have passed, hope and joy are the only things to stay!

steps.speaker: People In Parade
steps.content: The great DisCity! <size=33>The great DisCity—!</size>

steps.speaker: Television Person
steps.content: The most wonderful performance is about to begin! Thanks to Hamel! Thanks to Hamel! You give us happiness, you give us love!

steps.speaker: People In Parade
steps.content: <size=44>Hamel—! Hamel—!</size>
Amid the colorful confetti flying in the sky, grand brilliance and ultimate absurdity are intertwined together.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It doesn't look like this at all from the outside...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate, have we been teleported somewhere else? Or am I dreaming?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This isn't a dream. And we're being surrounded by massive Mania. There's no mistaking it, we're inside the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But this place is so different from the square. Any street corner in Syndicate seems more intimidating than this place.
You remember it vividly.

Not only that, this place is also different from the basement of SALVA and the Unclaimed Crypt. There aren't any visible contaminations. No frantic, furious monsters. Only a carnival like endless reveries.

steps.speaker: Che
steps.content: This is the Ring born from Zoya. Every rule here, including the laws of physics and spacetime, is governed by her will. This is her realm.
Is it because BR-001's owner has an extraordinarily special mind?
(Transition) Portrait of dark Hamel emerges with laughter
But she doesn't look like someone who's so... cheerful.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Let's follow the parade and see where it leads us.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But be careful, I'm afraid this place is not as simple as it appears.
You pass through the amusement park's gate and are about to join the marching parade.
The several mascots closest to you seem to sense something. Their heads turn in unnatural arcs and those big dark eyes are fixed on you.

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: ...Hu...mans? Hahaha, fools!

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: Lost again! Lost again! There are fool who have lost their way again!

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: Send him back, send him back! This is our parade, you shouldn't be here, you don't belong here...
steps.female_content: Send her back, send her back! This is our parade, you shouldn't be here, you don't belong here...

steps.content: They all suddenly turn toward you synchronously. Amid the creepy music, they are swarming in your direction with synchronized footsteps.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoa! We're being attacked, ${PlayerName}, back off, back off...!
No, the mascots are not attacking you. They're only pushing at you, trying to kick you out of the parade.

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: Go back! Go back! This place doesn't belong to you! <size=44>You shouldn't be here...!</size>

steps.speaker: Mascots
steps.content: You won't get to see Hamel—! Hamel won't see you—! <size=44>She won't see you—!</size>

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are they going nuts?! ${PlayerName}, think of something quick!
